ZED (art) Function word: a sample article
A ZED IS SET.
The zed is set.

flonk (v) SHIFT (v) IF THE GAUGE FLONKS,
SHIFT THE SWITCH.
If the gauge flonks, shift the switch.

ZORBLE (adj) Prepared or supplied for
you to use
IF THE ZORBLE IS READY, DO A TEST.
The zorble is ready.

SHIFT (v) Move a part from one place to another.
IF THE SWITCH IS SHIFTED, CHECK THE LAMP.

grimp (adj) SOLID (adj) THE GRIMP IS SOLID.
A grimp part is not solid.

make zork (v) BUILD (v) MAKE A ZORK NOW.
Build a zork.
